title: Cannot reassign "Shortcut to toggle Easy Mouse" after using "Clear"

status.label: Shortcut editor clear-state fix candidate
status.detail: The report isolates Clear-then-reassign and includes a diagnostic ZIP and screenshots.

judgment.rationale: The reporter supplies a reproducible sequence and controls: an existing shortcut works, Clear removes it, then the editor accepts no keys; a never-assigned field and direct replacement still work. Current ShortcutControl code clears to empty HotkeySettings and refreshes displayed keys, but this inspection does not prove why capture stops. A focused reproduction should establish whether keyboard-hook/focus state is lost before correction.
evidence: PowerToys 0.101.2362 from GitHub; Mouse Without Borders settings.
After Clear no tested key/modifier is detected; initially empty assignment and direct replacement work.
Diagnostic ZIP and two screenshots are attached; US keyboard and Japanese display language reported.
No comments, duplicate link, assignee, or linked fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce in the shared shortcut control, compare hook/focus state after Clear versus direct replacement, and add coverage before selecting a fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A Settings fix appears applicable if the editor loses keyboard-capture state after clearing; the precise focus/hook failure is not confirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep the hotkey editor listening after Clear
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: clearing a populated shortcut resets HotkeySettings but leaves shortcut-editor capture/focus or keyboard-hook state stale, preventing new key events. The sequence isolates Clear, but no trace confirms the state mismatch.
plan: Reproduce existing binding → Clear → new binding and compare active ShortcutControl hook, dialog focus, and key callbacks against an initially empty field and direct replacement.
Ensure Clear resets only the saved key value while preserving or re-establishing active capture until the editor is dismissed.
Add UI regression coverage that clears an existing Easy Mouse shortcut and successfully assigns a supported new combination.
verification: On a current build, assign a shortcut, clear it, and immediately try Ctrl+Alt+M, Shift+M, and another supported combination.
Compare with assigning an initially empty field and directly replacing an existing shortcut.
Run focused Settings UI validation; confirm dismissing after Clear preserves the empty value.

confidence.rationale: The sequence is clear, but no source trace identifies whether hook, focus, or key validation is responsible; the fix depends on reproduction.

issue_context.summary: Clearing an existing Easy Mouse shortcut removes its value but leaves the editor unable to capture a replacement combination.
known_information: PowerToys v0.101.2362, GitHub installation, Mouse Without Borders.
After Clear the editor accepts no tested key; initially empty assignment and direct replacement still work.
Reporter provides screenshots, diagnostic ZIP, US keyboard layout, Japanese display language.
No comments, assignees, or linked fix/duplicate.
inferences: The contrast suggests a transition-specific editor state issue, not unsupported keys.
Keyboard capture/focus is a candidate mechanism, not confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The report is concrete enough for maintainer UI reproduction. Current ShortcutControl clear handling writes an empty HotkeySettings and refreshes displayed keys; this does not prove the hook is disabled. Compare event/focus state rather than ask for another diagnostic.
initial_investigation: Read full issue body, labels/assignees, and attachment links; no discussion comments.
Inspected current ShortcutControl clear handler: C_ClearClick writes empty HotkeySettings and calls SetKeys; this alone does not explain lost input.
Current source history shows PR #49662 (2026-09-18) changed shortcut editor keyboard handling; no fix is linked from this issue.
Targeted upstream search found no other issue with this exact clear-then-reassign symptom.

Rechecked all eight assign/Clear/reassign steps and controls: direct replacement and never-assigned fields work. #51077 is grouping only, so preserve the shared-shortcut-control proposal and capture/focus reproduction.

reproduce.module: Settings - Mouse Without Borders shortcut editor
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.101.2362 or current build; record exact version
prerequisites: Open Settings to Mouse Without Borders.
Use a supported combination and US keyboard layout as reported.
steps: Assign a supported shortcut to “Shortcut to toggle Easy Mouse” and verify it works.
Open editor, press Clear, confirm value is empty.
Without closing the editor, press Ctrl+Alt+M and observe if any key is captured.
Repeat with Shift+M and another supported combination.
Compare with an initially empty field and direct replacement without Clear.
Trace keyboard-hook activation, focus, and KeyDown callback immediately after Clear.
reproduce.expected_result: After Clear the value is empty and the active editor continues accepting a valid new combination.
setup_requirements: Record exact build, keyboard layout, and whether dialog remains focused.
Do not expose private shortcut/configuration values beyond test combinations.
